title_zh: 请诊所转交慢性疼痛咨询的回电请求

scenario.label_zh: 转交慢性疼痛临床咨询回电请求
scenario.goal_zh: 说明慢性疼痛咨询需求，并确认接待员已将下午回电请求转交临床团队

context_zh: 虚构诊所电话沟通中，患者询问专业咨询渠道；不作诊断或治疗建议。
author: author-phase10-a

sentences.speaker: Hazel
sentences.text: I'd like to speak to someone about chronic pain. My doctor suggested I contact your service.

sentences.speaker: Receptionist Amir
sentences.text: I can send a callback request to the clinical team. I can't advise on treatment myself.

sentences.speaker: Hazel
sentences.text: That's fine. I mainly want to ask how an initial consultation works.

sentences.speaker: Receptionist Amir
sentences.text: When can you take a call?

sentences.speaker: Hazel
sentences.text: Any time after two this afternoon. You can use the number on my record.

sentences.speaker: Receptionist Amir
sentences.text: I've sent that request with your preferred time. The team will confirm when they can call; I haven't booked a consultation.

sentences.speaker: Hazel
sentences.text: Thank you. I'll wait for their call before making an appointment.
